execution_audit.overrun_reason: The configured trigger requires two expected invocations without valid assignment-bound progress. The new active-pool overlay has not yet completed one clean full recurrence cycle at the frozen snapshot.

optimization.decision: Keep the current 17-role Phase-1 allocation unchanged for one expected post-overlay cycle. Revision churn now would delay convergence and make assignment evidence harder to attribute.

postfreeze_observation.policy_action: Do not inspect or reinterpret the newer O_OPERATIONS semantics in this invocation. Persist the audit under the frozen tuple and require a fresh all-control bootstrap next invocation.

rollback.rollback_action: No substantive control rollback is applicable because no configuration changed. If this audit checkpoint itself must be reverted, restore the predecessor state/ledger blobs; do not alter the Phase-1 overlays.

termination.reason: Phase 1 is still waiting for its first complete assignment-bound post-overlay evidence cycle. Current old-tuple receipts show safe freeze/checkpoint behavior, not a control defect requiring immediate reallocation.

exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap all automation_control files, including the newer O_OPERATIONS state, before any role-artifact semantics.
Inspect the first root16/downstream25 assignment-bound receipts for all active role classes and populate the 17-cell acceptance matrix only from exact current provenance.
If a role completes or blocks a Phase-1 leaf, reassign it to the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; never restore base work merely on leaf completion.

If any active role lacks valid substantive assignment-bound evidence after two expected invocations, generate at least one alternative allocation/method branch, compare expected time-to-root, and reforecast.
Do not transition to Phase 2 until all active proof cells pass; on acceptance transition directly to a full-pool primary-objective portfolio without a blanket base-work interval.
